metadata.datasource: Measured off Kodak F-4017 (2021), KODAK PROFESSIONAL TRI-X 400 Film / 400TX, 35 mm, D-76 developer, large tank, 8 min at 20 C, diffuse visual density. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 400; base + fog 0.297. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: the D = 1.0 over gross fog curve (equal-energy, erg/cm^2, effective exposure 0.5 s). One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
